meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor

future: буду / будешь ... + infinitive

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: Russian preposition meaning 'in' that governs a specific oblique case on the following noun phrase.
Secondary conversational sense ('into, to') (+ accusative (where to)) used in spoken Russian dialogue.

meanings.note: Declinable feminine noun meaning 'thing', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

meanings.note: Invariable Russian adverb used to modify verbs or whole clauses with the sense 'together'.

meanings.note: Conversational Russian particle ('here') that adds modal nuance, emphasis, or discourse tone in spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Qualitative or relational adjective formed with the productive '-н-' suffix, meaning 'home' and agreeing in gender, number, and case.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'friend' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

meanings.note: Descriptive Russian adjective meaning 'busy', agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.

emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Подведём итоги твоей первой рабочей недели.

meanings.note: Russian preposition meaning 'to' that governs a specific oblique case on the following noun phrase.

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought
meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'умать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to think', forming an aspectual pair with 'думать'.

examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: to play a prank on, to tease, to trick
meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'шутить'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to play a prank', forming an aspectual pair with 'подшучивать'.

examples.trans: The guys played a prank on you.

examples.text: Вот это парни над тобой подшутили!

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'ехать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to go', forming an aspectual pair with 'ехать'.

meanings.note: Invariable Russian adverb used to modify verbs or whole clauses with the sense 'why'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'езжать'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to come', forming an aspectual pair with 'приехать'.

Russian perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to come', forming an aspectual pair with 'приходить'; conjugates for person and number in the present/future and agrees in gender in the past tense.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лучиться'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to happen', forming an aspectual pair with 'случаться'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.

examples.text: Марина, я вам обещаю: со стеной ничего не случится.
examples.trans: Marina, I promise you: nothing will happen to the wall.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лышать'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to hear', forming an aspectual pair with 'услышать'.
Secondary conversational sense ('to hear about') (слышать о + prepositional) used in spoken Russian dialogue.
